svg.text: Standard service names resolve through central private DNS
Both caller networks use the private IP
of afw-hub as their DNS server
Central private DNS zones (outside the VNet)
Azure Policy registers private endpoint DNS zone groups
Caller sends the standard service hostname query to the afw-hub DNS proxy
The DNS proxy forwards it to Azure-provided DNS in the hub VNet context
Hub-linked central private DNS zones supply the private endpoint record
Answer returned to the caller: a private address in 10.20.n.64/26
HTTPS to standard Blob hostname; private destination IP
no private endpoint or custom SQL
DNS answers are not data packets: step 1-4 resolve a name, then the caller connects over the network to the private endpoint address.
Peering and routing for these connections are shown in diagrams 04 and 08.
